purpose: Skeleton-first foot audit. Test the user's observed oversized-foot issue against measurement-compatible adult male metatarsal/phalangeal radiographic data.

measurement_compatibility.metatarsals: Strong. Patil 2017 measures distal metatarsal head to midpoint of base articular surface; a003 uses TMT/base to metatarsal head.
measurement_compatibility.proximal_middle_phalanges: Moderate-to-strong. Patil uses articular-surface midpoint to midpoint; a003 uses joint/station endpoints.
measurement_compatibility.distal_phalanges: Weaker. a003 distal segments terminate at a tip station that may include soft tissue beyond the distal phalanx.

hallux_distal_phalanx.measurement_warning: a003 distal phalanx tail may extend to a surface/toe-tip station; direct osteometric equivalence is weaker than for metatarsals/proximal/middle phalanges.

toe2_distal_phalanx.measurement_warning: a003 distal phalanx tail may extend to a surface/toe-tip station; direct osteometric equivalence is weaker than for metatarsals/proximal/middle phalanges.

toe3_distal_phalanx.measurement_warning: a003 distal phalanx tail may extend to a surface/toe-tip station; direct osteometric equivalence is weaker than for metatarsals/proximal/middle phalanges.

toe4_distal_phalanx.measurement_warning: a003 distal phalanx tail may extend to a surface/toe-tip station; direct osteometric equivalence is weaker than for metatarsals/proximal/middle phalanges.

toe5_distal_phalanx.measurement_warning: a003 distal phalanx tail may extend to a surface/toe-tip station; direct osteometric equivalence is weaker than for metatarsals/proximal/middle phalanges.

findings: All five a003 metatarsal spans are above the Patil 2017 male means by roughly 12-19 mm; every metatarsal is >2 SD high, and M2 is >5 SD high.
Hallux and lesser-toe proximal/middle phalanx spans are also substantially long versus the same adult male radiographic sample; many exceed 3 SD.
The direct bone-span evidence therefore confirms that the oversized-foot problem is not only skin/soft-tissue length: the a003 foot armature was itself stretched to fit the long r95 foot.
This is expected because a003 was deliberately a mesh-fit audit. Under the skeleton-first policy, metatarsals and toe phalanges must be re-targeted independently, then the mesh shortened around them.
Distal phalanx comparisons are not used alone for acceptance because the a003 tip station may include terminal soft tissue.
next_steps: Cross-check metatarsal corridors against at least one additional measurement-compatible adult male sample before freezing exact lengths.
Derive hindfoot/midfoot joint-to-joint targets separately; do not compare current tarsal rig-stick lengths to whole-bone maximum dimensions.
Retarget toe proximal/middle phalanges from compatible radiographic data; model distal tips with a separate soft-tissue allowance.
Once the canonical foot chain is frozen, reduce the production mesh foot length around the skeleton and re-run ankle/subtalar/talonavicular/hallux tests.
